items.html:
A very consistent all-rounder in the UAE side. Frequently  sport-
ing a beard, this hard-hitting right-hand batsman and off-spinner
hails from the city of Lahore in  Pakistan.  He was  declared   a
joint  man-of-the-tournament  at the ICC Trophy in Kenya 1994 due
to an excellent all-round performance with the bat and the  ball.
He  briefly represented Pakistan in one-day internationals before
moving to the UAE.
